title: 60FPS City scale destruction, starring definitely NOT Godzilla
author: WorkAccountObv
selftext:
This is a POC I've been slowly digging away at on and off for years. There were major limitations to implementing this with any sort of reasonable performance. I have been a software engineer for 20 years, but unfortunately some of the scaling and algorithms required to make it happen were out of my skillset. AI has helped get me over a few hurdles and hangups and helped prove this is possible even on moderate modern hardware. 

This is not self promotion, as this, at this point is not going to become a real game, more of just a tech demo at this point. 

Thousands if not millions of physics objects with accurate, load bearing destruction of the skyscrapers.

comments.author: TheSpanxxx
comments.body:
Pretty dang cool.

Some things I think I would chase down 

1)  "character" models and animations and character collision animations. I would work on an engine that allows for different character model body shapes as a way to extend what your visual options could be. Think dense polygon models in various body style/shapes that you can then scale proportionally and layer with skin textures and designs. That would give you some optionality in your models with vast amounts of differentiation possible. And by focusing in that manner you can work on each model having custom character collision and movement animations. 

2) I would try to add a quick zoom in/out ability that let you get in close and see the characters hit structures and then see all that great demolition action up close and personal. 

Neat idea and concept so far! Rampage 3d here we come!

replies.author: WorkAccountObv
replies.body:
It's taken a lot more than 5 hours unfortunately, with many road blocks. 

A lot of the research and ideas were implemented years ago in different engines. It's only been recently that I've been able to target specific theories and apply different strategies to get where this is right now. 

You can prob get the basics down pretty quick, looking for a load bearing building destruction system, but expect to run into scaling issues fast with thousands of objects.

replies.author: WorkAccountObv
replies.body:
This is using unreal but a mostly custom physics system built on other open source ones. 

The hanging of the one building is mostly some limits I’ve put on the velocity and speed at which things can change direction or accelerate which prevents random objects from going hyper speed in one direction or another which breaks the illusion. 

Think illusion, think threads and think faking anything that doesn’t need read calculation and have fun!
